## prompt-4-final-protocol

*Generated by Process A from the master prompt in
[`../prompts/prompt-protocol.md`](../prompts/prompt-protocol.md), adapting
`inputs/auto-bill-02/sub-prompts/prompt-7-final-bill.md` and the human
corrections visible across the auto-bill-02 draft-to-full-to-final cycle, to the
Physical AI oncology trial protocol. Runs in stage
`trial-protocol/final-protocol/` (no `publication` subdirectory).*

Produce the polished, **final** Phase 1 protocol LaTeX and zip into
`trial-protocol/final-protocol/`, so its context and formatting quality match
and exceed `trial-protocol/full-protocol/`. Start from the full protocol and
apply the corrections a senior clinical-regulatory author would make, learning
from the improvements visible across the auto-bill-02 cycle: tune the
bibliography appearance with correct white-space formatting so no line ends with
a single stranded word; balance every page with `\clearpage`, `\vspace`, and
`\hspace`; confirm every table column width uses
`>{\raggedright\arraybackslash}p{<width>}` at the body measure; verify single
hyphens only and the section symbol § for every codified reference (21 CFR
§312.x, §812.x); verify every dose level, force cap, vessel threshold, advisory
window, and sample-size figure is internally consistent across sections; and
confirm the clickable, page-filling table of contents lists every NIH section
and the back matter.

**Maximum-quality pass (Stage 4).** Double-verify all context and formatting.
Re-examine every TikZ figure for text-box/arrow overlaps, correct curved-arrow
looseness, and box spacing, improving any figure that fell short in the full
stage. Implement the author's `\clearpage`, table-column-width, `\vspace`, and
`\hspace` methods and the author's other proof-reading techniques so each
section and page is self-standing and properly formatted, with no overcrowding
and no large empty white spaces. Avoid single or two-word lines and any single
line stranded on the next page. Include the **ORCID logo and ORCID URL**
correctly (rendered without any PNG, as a TikZ iD mark) and the DOI
`10.5281/zenodo.xxxxxxxx`
([https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.xxxxxxxx](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.xxxxxxxx)),
version v4.0.0, June 20, 2026.

**Content.** Carry the complete protocol in its improved, final form: every NIH
section addressed; the combined IND/IDE Phase 1 design; the daraxonrasib drug
arm and robotic Whipple device arm; the three counterfactual PFS/OS scenarios;
the eight Physical AI concerns and mitigations; the full safety, statistical,
and oversight machinery; and the back matter. The three media (full-width
tables, centered ASCII, TikZ `mermaidfig`) are balanced, each used only where it
is the correct representation. No images; white background throughout.

**Files and commit schedule (Rules 6, 7, 8).** One commit each for `main.tex`,
`protostyle.sty`, `references.bib`, and `README.md`; one commit per
`sections/*.tex`. File `prompt-final-protocol.md` (this prompt verbatim under a
`## prompt-final-protocol` heading) and `output-final-protocol.md`. Push every
commit in real time (10+ commits). The second-to-last commit fixes all errors
across all files. For the last commit, perform the remaining repository updates
(Rule 7): the v4.0.0 entries in root `CHANGELOG.md` and `releases.md`, the root
`README.md` updates (2x badges, ASCII diagrams, table of contents, repository
structure, a new version section, protocol tables and colored Mermaid), the
`final-protocol/README.md`, the `final-protocol-LaTeX.zip`, and
`../prompts/output-protocol.md`. Do not stall, ask questions, or go into plan
mode. The LaTeX must compile in Overleaf with pdfLaTeX.
